verdicts.requirement: Change the phone number of my address "My address" to 305-555-0199.
verdicts.reasoning: The server got a POST that edits the address with alias "My address" and sets phone to 305-555-0199. It also resubmitted the other fields (name, street, Miami, Florida, US, 33133). The server answered with a 302 redirect to /addresses, which means the save was accepted. The address probe taken after the task shows "My address" with phone "305-555-0199" and its other fields unchanged. The other address, "Mon adresse", was not touched. The final URL shows id_address=7 while the POST went to id_address=5. This fits PrestaShop's normal behavior of saving an edited address under a new id when the old one is used by existing orders.
